description: Pins of the vu monorepo (planned repository aphrody-labs/vu), written like config/vendor.json: sources are fetched on demand, shallow and blobless, never vendored into Git. Each pin is an exact commit of an aphrody-labs fork whose branch `vu-pin-<version>` was created at the upstream release commit on 2026-10-05; the same facts are recorded in config/upstream-sources.json (ids vu-uv, vu-ruff, vu-pyo3, vu-python-build-standalone). `scripts/audit/workspace/vu-pins.ts` checks both files against each other and, with --online, against GitHub.

sources.name: uv
sources.libraryEntrypoint: uv::main(args) -> ExitCode (pub unsafe fn, crates/uv/src/lib.rs); uv::run(cli, GlobalInitialization)

sources.name: ruff
sources.libraryEntrypoint: ruff::run(Args) -> Result<ExitStatus> (pub fn, crates/ruff/src/lib.rs); installs a global panic hook
sources.note: ty lives in this repository (crates/ty*, the ty crate is version 0.0.0 and publish = false). ty 0.0.84 vendors ruff 11aaa39f84c0c44bdfb4c9cc21e4038c6f74c00a, 107 commits behind this pin; no separate branch is created.

sources.name: pyo3
sources.note: Same version as the Aphrody workspace Cargo.lock (0.29.3), so the aphrody_rust extension and the vu runtime share one PyO3.
